card.name: Subject right before 'is used/administered'
card.fires_on: The subject word just before a verb of use or administration, such as 'is' after a brand drug name in a dosage section, or 'one', 'you' or 'mark' in explanatory text. The next word is likely 'used' or 'administered'.

modes.label: Drug name then is
modes.description: The word 'is' right after a capitalized brand name in an Administration or Dosage heading section.
modes.example: 2.4 Administration Instructions SPRAVATO<< is>> for nasal use only.

modes.label: Subject in explanatory text
modes.description: A pronoun or noun as subject in a sentence explaining a custom or what a term is used for.

card.plain: It fires on the subject slot just before the text says how something is used or given.
